evidence.title: Agility Robotics Highlights Commercial Momentum and Growing Enterprise Demand for Digit Humanoid Robot
evidence.excerpt: SALEM, Ore. — October 26, 2026 — Agility Robotics , a leading humanoid robotics and physical AI company, today highlighted growing commercial momentum for Digit®, including an expanded relationship with existing customer GXO, three additional manufacturing customers and an active pipeline of more than 30 prospective customers across automotive manufacturing, logistics, e-commerce, agricultural equipment, consumer products and defense. Agility CEO Peggy Johnson will discuss the company's commercial progress and outlook during an investor conference call and webcast today at 12:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Details for accessing the call are provided below. In a separate announcement today, GXO announced a new commercial agreement to deploy Digit at two additional U.S. facilities in Statesville, North Carolina, and Lebanon, Tennessee. The expansion builds on Digit’s work at GXO’s Georgia facility since 2024 and demonstrates Agility’s commercial growth strategy in action: establish value in an initial deployment, then expand across a customer’s operations. Deployments are expected to begin in early 2027 using Digit 4, with plans to transition to Digit 5 as it becomes commercially available. G
